scope: Private checked Stringable operand conversion for finite-provider chdir
contract: A weak positional chdir object with a source-checked __toString method runs the callback before requesting an OS directory fact. The original object remains in the call for trace and selection provenance. The resulting bytes enter an append-only conversion log; the pending DIRCONTEXT requires its exact latest record, owning frame, source site, call line, selected-call nonce and object. The callback can change CWD before the outer request, whose lookup captures the new CWD. Direct, computed-string and owned first-class calls share this route. Strict or non-stringable objects raise TypeError before callback; NUL returned by the callback raises ValueError before any OS request. Ordinary no-snapshot chdir has one explicit Unsupported reached transition.
